summary_1line: Rama pursues and kills the demon Maricha disguised as a golden deer, who dies crying out in Rama’s voice to lure Lakshmana away.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama draws a blazing arrow and releases it as the golden deer leaps through the forest clearing.
The arrow strikes the deer mid‑leap, and the creature transforms into the huge demon Maricha, bloodied and collapsing to the earth.
Dying Maricha in demon form cries out 'O Sita, O Lakshmana!' in Rama’s voice while lying wounded in the forest.
